description: Deterministic synchronization receipt emitted to stdout and optionally to ignored/private runtime storage.
sanitized_tracking_rules: Tracked/public projections remove provider_revision, provider_change_token, local_scratch_path, raw baseline-store location, and raw locator/account identity.
Provider/baseline fingerprints are retained only when one-way and unusable as locators.
A provider-bound push/reconcile mutation must not report SYNCED until provider write and provider read-back verification both succeed.
A pull may report SYNCED without a provider write after provider freshness/read and local content verification succeed.
The durable baseline advances only after the operation's required verification succeeds; blocked/failed operations do not advance it.
A blocked or failed sync does not disable future checkpoint or periodic attempts.
